knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A site assessment confirms the scope, access, surfaces, hazards and restrictions before a firm quote is given. A phone call alone (option 0) and promising a result (option 2) are the errors the lesson lists.

A hazard found on site is recorded, checked for whether the job can be done safely, and the scope is adjusted or the job referred before quoting. Ignoring it (option 0) and starting the job to deal with it later (option 2) are the unsafe options.
The lesson says to ask what the customer wants done, what matters most, when they need it, who will be present, and whether there are pets or children.

practicalCriteria: Learner asks the discovery questions and records the answers in the customer record before a quote is prepared.
Learner carries out a site assessment that records size, access, surfaces, soil, hazards and restrictions.
Learner photographs only with consent and under the privacy procedure, and does not photograph personal items.
Learner records the agreed scope with exclusions, and the scope matches the assessment findings.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Discovery record with the customer's needs, priorities and constraints
Site assessment record with findings, consented photographs and agreed scope
stopWorkCriteria: Learner issues a firm quote before seeing the site
Learner starts work on a hazard that has not been recorded and checked for safe completion
